name: Crypto stress
summary: Bitcoin 10% off its high; Binance under strain after record $6.3bn theft
state: Bitcoin was near $77,600 on 4 Nov, about 10% below its 52-week high, which alone would be Normal. Watch rests on Binance, a top-10 exchange: after the FBI attributed a $6.3bn theft to North Korea, customers withdrew about $4.6bn on 1 Nov, a net outflow of $3.6bn (ABC). Binance says it has replenished most stolen assets; Pyongyang denied the theft on 3 Nov.
for_you: Crypto holders on exchanges are exposed to platform failures and theft; most crypto is not covered by deposit protection.
rubric_hit: Top-10 exchange (Binance) under stress = Watch; BTC drawdown 10% < 25%
basis_detail: raised above the data floor on reported events

sources.title: ABC News (Australia) — North Korea denies Binance heist as customers withdraw billions
CoinDesk — Binance's $6.3bn hack began with a fake job interview

why: Crypto is now plumbed into mainstream finance via ETFs and stablecoins; a crash or de-peg can spill into funding markets.
drivers: Liquidity, leverage, regulation, stablecoin reserves, exchange solvency.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.
rubric.watch: Drawdown 25–45%, or a top-10 exchange/stablecoin under stress.
rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
